intro.en: Clothes that fit or do not, what happens to them in the wash, and the vocabulary of paying and complaining.

texto.en:
**How it fits.** **Quedar** + adjective, like gustar: **me queda apretado** (tight), **flojo** (loose), **ajustado**, **amplio**, **largo**, **corto**. **Me aprietan** los zapatos. **Me sienta bien** means it suits me.

**What happens to clothes.** **Encoger** (to shrink): **ha encogido** en la lavadora. **Dar de sí** (to stretch): el jersey **ha dado de sí**. **Desteñir** (to run). **Arrugarse**. A seam **se descose**, and you **coses** it with **aguja** and **hilo**. A coat goes **al tinte** to be cleaned **en seco**.

**Parts.** **La cremallera**, **los botones**, **el bolsillo**, **la manga**, **el cuello**. In the shop: **la percha**, **la etiqueta**, **el probador**.

**Kinds.** **Ropa de temporada**, **de abrigo**, **de cama**. **Liso** or **estampado**, **de rayas**, **de cuadros**. **Está de moda**, **está pasado de moda**.

**In the shop.** **Solo estoy echando un vistazo.** **¿Quién da la vez?** (who is last in the queue?)

**Paying.** **Al contado** (all at once) or **a plazos** (in instalments), **con tarjeta** or **en efectivo**. To reserve something you **dejas una señal**. You ask for **la factura** or **el recibo**, and before a big job, **un presupuesto**.

**Complaining.** Every Spanish business must have **hojas de reclamaciones**. You **pides la hoja de reclamaciones** and **pones una reclamación**. **El consumidor** has rights: **la garantía**, **la devolución**, **el cambio**.

frases.es: Buenos días. Compré esta chaqueta hace una semana y, al lavarla, ha encogido dos tallas.
frases.en: Good morning. I bought this jacket a week ago and, on washing it, it has shrunk two sizes.

frases.es: ¿La lavó en casa? En la etiqueta pone que hay que llevarla al tinte.
frases.en: Did you wash it at home? The label says it has to be taken to the dry cleaner's.

frases.es: La etiqueta se había descosido y no la vi. Además, la cremallera ya venía rota.
frases.en: The label had come unstitched and I didn't see it. Besides, the zip was already broken when I got it.

frases.es: Lo lamento. Si tiene la factura, puedo cambiársela por otra, pero no devolverle el dinero.
frases.en: I'm sorry. If you have the invoice, I can exchange it for another one, but not give you your money back.

frases.es: La pagué al contado y aquí está el recibo. Preferiría que me devolvieran el dinero.
frases.en: I paid for it in cash and here is the receipt. I would prefer you to give me my money back.

frases.es: Eso no depende de mí. Si quiere, le traigo la hoja de reclamaciones.
frases.en: That is not up to me. If you like, I'll bring you the complaints form.

bloques.frase: Quiero poner una reclamación por este producto

traduccion.en: I want to make a complaint about this product.

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (150–180 words).** Write a formal complaint on a complaints form about a faulty product and a shop that refuses to refund you.

**Speak (about 3 minutes).** Argue aloud with a shop assistant who will not accept a return, firmly but politely.
